definition: When a trade moves a zone width against it, open a larger trade the other way, and repeat, so that a move out of the zone either side closes the set in profit.
boundaries: Known failure: each turn multiplies the lot, as martingale does, so a price that swings inside the zone long enough needs a size the deposit cannot carry. Named so a unit, a source or he can point at it; its maths is the risk session's.
recognition: Losing trades are answered with bigger hedges the other way.

sources.quote: a counter-trade is triggered in the opposite direction with an increased lot size
sooner or later, the deposit becomes insufficient to finish the cycle
